environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). The application listens on port 8080, NLB forwards TCP traffic directly. No reverse proxy or application-layer filtering. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 with TLS termination at NLB. API keys are distributed to partner integrations via a shared secrets manager.

config.network: VPC with public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound
config.reverse_proxy: none - NLB forwards directly to Flask
